items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I had played with Hamp... I stayed with Hamp about a year or two... I left Hamp in Pittsburgh.

ctx.x: I didn't use the baritone. I just used the baritone when we didn't have a baritone player (inaudible).
Like when the time I came I had an alto and I had played with Hamp and I had left, he asked me to come in to play (inaudible). He say, "Come on and play some third alto. I need a third alto player."
